context: A mom and son chat after a play date
purpose: Teach: 佑/ケイ/オイラ/毎度/意地/過ち/泡/お出かけ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日、佑くんち行ってきた。ケイちゃんも来てた。
lines.en: Mom, I went to Yu-kun's house today. Kei-chan was there too.
lines.style: Eager, naturalistic report. Quick breathless delivery on the key detail. Small excitement underneath but contained—he's telling, not performing. Warm eye contact.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 楽しかった?「オイラ」って言葉、覚えたの?
lines.en: Did you have fun? Did you pick up that word—'oira'?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, interested in both the experience and what he learned. Warm maternal tone. Slight lift on the second question, showing she noticed him using it. Listening-forward posture.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!毎度の遊びに、新しいルール作って楽しんだ。
lines.en: Yeah! We made up new rules every time and kept having fun with it.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Energy on 'new rules'—he likes the structure. Conversational pace, natural enthusiasm without performing. Small proud note underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 意地を張らずに、皆で仲良くね。
lines.en: Make sure you all get along without being stubborn about things, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but steady guidance. Not lecturing. Quiet firmness underneath the warmth. Patient pause after the first clause, giving him space to receive it. Tender but clear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: けんかになりそうな過ちもあったけど、すぐ謝った。
lines.en: We almost got into a fight over something, but I said sorry right away.
lines.style: Quietly sincere. Small shame-note on 'almost got into a fight,' then quick relief on 'said sorry.' Matter-of-fact delivery—he's reporting what he did, not asking forgiveness. Genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お風呂の泡、いっぱい立てて、リラックスしてね。
lines.en: Run lots of bubbles in the bath and get yourself relaxed tonight, alright?
lines.style: Soft, settling tone. Practical care wrapped in gentleness. Slow, unhurried pace. Trailing warmth on the close—tucking him in vocally. Her voice creates safety.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 明日のお出かけ、楽しみ!
lines.en: I can't wait for tomorrow's outing!
lines.style: Genuine childlike excitement. Bright, forward-leaning energy. Quick, bright attack on the first word. Clean, unguarded joy. Small rising note at the end—open and uncomplicated.
